description: This PHP file defines an abstract class 'NormalizableDTO' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\DisplayField'. The class provides methods for normalizing data arrays, including fetching data via getter methods based on a mapping, making it foundational for data transfer object normalization in the OrangeHRM reporting module.

classes.name: NormalizableDTO
classes.description: An abstract class providing a blueprint for DTOs that can normalize data arrays based on field mappings and getter methods.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Abstract method intended to convert the DTO to an array, given specific fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Abstract method that returns a mapping of fields to getter methods.

methods.name: normalizeArray
methods.description: Normalizes an iterable data set into a structured array based on the field getter map.

methods.name: callGetterOnItem
methods.description: Calls getter methods on an item, potentially chaining multiple methods based on the getter array.
